# azureacme_certificate (Data Source)

The full public representation of one certificate registration, INCLUDING the volatile status the resource deliberately omits. This is how one workspace consumes a certificate registered by another without gaining the ability to change it.

It never causes issuance, renewal or an ACME order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The cross-workspace CONSUMPTION path. Strictly read-only: it never claims
# ownership, cannot create, and requires only Certificates.Read — so an
# application workspace can consume a certificate registered by a platform
# workspace without gaining the ability to change it.
#
# Every volatile field deliberately kept off the resource lives here: status,
# delivery_stage, consumers[], operation, previous_certificate, renewal status,
# ownership, audit, system_labels, conditions and the dns_names AS ISSUED.

data "azureacme_certificate" "api" {
  namespace = "payments-prod"
  name      = "payments-api"
}

output "delivery" {
  value = {
    stage     = data.azureacme_certificate.api.delivery_stage
    not_after = data.azureacme_certificate.api.current_certificate.not_after
    consumers = data.azureacme_certificate.api.consumers
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)

### Optional

- `include_pem` (Boolean) Include the issued certificate and chain in PEM form. Defaults to `false`. **No private key is ever returned, under any flag.**

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `certificate_name` (String)
- `certificate_pem` (String) The issued leaf in PEM form, only when `include_pem = true`. **Never a private key.**
- `chain_pem` (String) The issuing chain in PEM form, only when `include_pem = true`. **Never a private key.**
- `conditions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `consumers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumers))
- `current_certificate` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--current_certificate))
- `deletion_policy` (String)
- `delivery_stage` (String) `consumer_unverifiable` is mandatory and must be surfaced: silence must never read as success.
- `description` (String)
- `dns_names` (Set of String) The identifiers in the SPECIFICATION.
- `fulfilled_generation` (Number)
- `generation` (Number)
- `id` (String) `{namespace}/{name}`.
- `issued_dns_names` (Set of String) The identifiers in the certificate ACTUALLY ISSUED, which may lag the specification.
- `key_vault_id` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `lifecycle_state` (String) `active`, `suspended`, `authorization_revoked`, `deleting` or `deleted`.
- `operation` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operation))
- `ownership` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ownership))
- `phase` (String)
- `previous_certificate` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--previous_certificate))
- `publication_mode` (String)
- `registration_id` (String)
- `renewal` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--renewal))
- `resolved_acme_profile` (String)
- `resolved_certificate_name` (String)
- `resolved_validation_binding` (String)
- `service_instance_id` (String)
- `spec_revision` (Number)
- `system_labels` (Map of String) Service-owned metadata. Separate from `labels` so the service never writes into the client's.
- `versionless_certificate_id` (String)
- `versionless_secret_id` (String) The consumption binding point.
